purpose: Verify GTK4 consumes the KDE GtkConfig export after the product GTK4 palette refresh writes and selects its mirrored theme variant.

runtime.input_export: The actual GTK4 colors.css emitted by KDE GtkConfig in R91; SHA-256 84d85337d3cb37719134972f87546eb9bb5a0276d9eaff6d08bb5071dea028a6
runtime.profile: Private HOME/XDG trees in ~/tempia; no installed or personal configuration changed

results.palette_refresh: passed; 13 CSS entries were mirrored, then the private selected theme switched from DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE to DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE-Reload
results.fresh_gtk4_application_theme: DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE-Reload, read from Gtk.Settings without GTK_THEME override

change.reason: The two already-modified tooltip CSS files had stale hashes in the manifest, so gtk4_palette_runtime.refresh rejected its own source before writing any mirrors.
change.scope: Only these two hashes changed. All 257 files now match their manifest; the sibling DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE manifest also verifies without mismatches.

diagnostics: The first probe attempt used an intentionally incomplete isolated HOME and therefore lacked the second GTK theme root required by roots_for(). No product files were changed by that attempt.

The first refresh against the checkout's then-stale manifest was rejected before its transaction began. After updating only the two manifest hashes to match the existing tooltip CSS edits, the private refresh and fresh GTK4 consumer passed.
limits: The actual KDE export file is from R91, but this private runtime test used local notify/settings callbacks that update only the isolated profile; it did not invoke the user's KDED D-Bus setter or alter the live color scheme.
The fresh GTK4 consumer opened one tooltip after refresh; R110 covers actual pointer hover across four palettes, while R87 covers the 31-target hover/geometry matrix in its recorded palette.
No historical pixel fidelity or human visual approval is claimed.
conclusion: The production GTK4 palette refresh now accepts its own source manifest and writes role-mirrored CSS; a fresh GTK4 process selected the reload variant and rendered the actual KDE-exported BreezeDark Tooltip face/text. R91 covers KDE's real export event and R110/R87 cover hover and palette behavior. T07 remains in progress.
